ranked_evidence.title: Supreme Court's Special Lok Adalat: Clear Pending Cases from July 29 - August 3, 2024
ranked_evidence.snippet:
Supreme Court's Special Lok Adalat: Clear Pending Cases from July 29 - August 3, 2024
NEWS ON AIR OFFICIAL
784000 subscribers
71 likes
2440 views
24 Jul 2024
In a landmark initiative to address pending cases and encourage amicable resolutions, the #SupremeCourt is hosting a Special #LokAdalat from July 29th to August 3rd, 2024. Celebrating the Supreme Court's 75th year of establishment, Chief Justice of India D.Y. Chandrachud urges citizens with pending cases before the Apex Court to seize this opportunity for a swift resolution. Don't miss this historic event aimed at expediting justice and fostering settlement.
